Classroom.title: Classroom
Classroom.description: Represents a physical or virtual classroom homeroom group with assigned students, schedule, and room reference.

id.description: The unique identifier for the classroom (slug or code).

name.description: The name or subject code of the classroom.

room.description: Room identifier number or location label.

instructor.description: The name of the leading teacher or instructor.

Student.title: Student
Student.description: Represents a student enrolled in the classroom, their grades, status, seating layout, and accumulated reward stars.

id.description: The unique identifier for the student.

avatar.description: URL to the student's avatar image.

grade.description: The student's grade percentage from 0 to 100.

stars.description: The student's accumulated star balance to spend in the reward store.

status.description: The student's current attendance and participation status.

consecutiveAbsences.description: The number of consecutive days the student has been marked absent.

isPresent.description: Whether the student is physically present in the classroom today.

RewardItem.title: RewardItem
RewardItem.description: An item in the classroom store that students can unlock by redeeming their stars.

id.description: The unique identifier of the reward.

description.description: Detailed description of the reward perks.

cost.description: The star cost required to purchase/redeem this reward.

category.description: Category categorization for sorting and layout.

popular.description: Whether the reward is marked as a trending/popular item.

premium.description: Whether the reward is a high-value premium tier.

Invoice.title: Invoice
Invoice.description: Financial ledger billing invoices for student tuition fees.

DiaryPost.title: DiaryPost
DiaryPost.description: A collaborative interactive lesson entry recorded by teachers with associated homework checklist tasks.

id.description: Unique identifier of the study diary post.

topic.description: Academic topic and descriptive emoji marker (e.g., 'Fractions 🍕').

title.description: A descriptive title of the day's class focus.

content.description: Narrative paragraph of the class instruction.

homework.description: Nested inline checklist tasks that students can toggle to completed.

images.description: Visual board references associated with this class.

pdf.description: Worksheet pdf descriptor containing name and size string keys.

/classrooms/{classroomId}.description: Collection storing different classroom subjects and groups.

/students/{studentId}.description: Collection storing student details, seating nodes, grades, and stars.

/diaryPosts/{diaryPostId}.description: Collection storing daily dynamic school logs, tags and homework lists.
